compute_voc_average_precision: compute VOC average precision from precision and recall arrays with optional 07 metric
evaluate_single_class_detection: evaluate precision recall and average precision for a single object detection class
evaluate_multi_class_detection: evaluate precision recall and average precision across multiple object detection classes
evaluate_multi_class_multiprocessing: evaluate multi-class object detection metrics using multiprocessing for parallel computation
compute_3d_bounding_box_iou: compute 3D axis-aligned bounding box intersection over union for object detection evaluation
